verification.method: scripts/verify/norway.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth (2022 and now), density, land area; about three-quarters more than 1950
Density among the three lowest of European countries over 5 million (with Russia and Finland); life expectancy fourth among them after Switzerland, Italy, Spain
Net migration above natural increase every year since 2021; net migration positive in every table row from 1980
Fertility 1964 high, under 2.1 since 1975, 2023 low, now; deaths above births from 2036; peak 2050; New Zealand larger from 2063
Urban share 1950/2026/2050; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 62 of 62 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
